name: ClearGlass Inc.
mission: Paid cyber and AI-risk advisory for Ontario organizations, backed by public, plain-language thought leadership.

operator.name: Founder
operator.note: The only principal that can approve high or critical actions. Agents never hold this role.

objectives.title: Build a qualified pipeline of Ontario advisory clients
Establish ClearGlass as a local authority on cyber and AI risk
Run company operations through the governed Agent Office
objectives.metric: daily loop runs with a verified audit chain

objectives.title: Execute no external action without operator approval
objectives.target_source: invariant enforced by the policy engine

ideal_customer_profile.note: Scoring rubric inputs. The rubric is transparent: every point awarded is listed in the output.

approved_sources.label: Lists and notes supplied by the operator

brand_guidelines: Plain language. Short sentences. No hype.
Never invent statistics, client names, results, or quotes.
Every factual claim needs a source the operator can check; otherwise, phrase it as a question or a recommendation.
Ontario focus: write for local owners and operators, not for other security vendors.
No fear-based selling. Explain the risk, the control, and the first step.
Sign-off line: CLEARGLASS: See Through Everything
